'''Roscoe Wayne Marquand''' (born August 22, 1981) is an American actor. He is best known for his roles in film and television as {{wp|Aaron (The Walking Dead)|Aaron}} in the apocalyptic-horror series ''{{wp|The Walking Dead (TV series)|The Walking Dead}}'', alongside voicing numerous characters in the superhero animated series ''{{wp|Invincible (TV series)|Invincible}}'' and the {{wp|Red Skull}} in several {{wp|Marvel Comics}}-related works. In the [[Pokémon]] franchise, he voices [[Hassel]] in the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|HZ}}.

==Biography==
Marquand was born in {{wp|Fort Collins, Colorado}}. At a young age, he joined the {{wp|Boy Scouts of America}} where he attaned the rank of {{wp|Eagle Scout}}. In his youth, Marquand was a frequent victim of bullying due to being part of "all things nerdy" he was involved in, including the Boy Scouts.<ref>[https://www.yahoo.com/entertainment/walking-dead-5-things-didnt-know-ross-marquand-130039368.html]</ref> His interest into acting came after watching ''{{wp|X-Men: The Animated Series}}'' when it first aired on television in 1992 and seeing the show's depiction of {{wp|Wolverine (character)|Wolverine}} helped changed his life.<ref>[https://comicbook.com/tv-shows/news/x-men-97-wolverine-ross-marquand-animated-series-inspired-actor/]</ref>

He attended {{wp|University of Colorado at Boulder}} with a {{wp|Bachelor of Fine Arts|BFA}} in Theatre.
